Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

linearAlgebra 0.0.3

New

  • TestPositiveSemiDefinite(): TRUE when no eigenvalue is below -tol times the absolute value of the largest eigenvalue (tol = 1e-06). Zero eigenvalues pass. It restores the rule TestPositiveDefinite() used before 0.0.2.
  • Tests for TestPositiveSemiDefinite() and its internal .TestPositiveSemiDefinite().

linearAlgebra 0.0.2

Fixes

  • .LDL() returned a wrong D and L for a 1 x 1 matrix (diag() on a scalar builds an identity of that size); D and L are now built with nrow.
  • TestPositiveDefinite() passed matrices with a zero eigenvalue. An eigenvalue must now be above tol times the absolute value of the largest eigenvalue (tol = 1e-06), so positive semidefinite matrices return FALSE. This changes the result for semidefinite input.

Tests

  • A test file for every function, including regression tests for the two fixes.
  • Benchmarks (bench) in .setup/tests-benchmark/.

linearAlgebra 0.0.1

Initial release

  • The rProject template (0.0.66); private jeksterslab-psu/linearAlgebra, public ijapesigan/linearAlgebra.
  • Complete roxygen for every function; internal functions use @noRd.
  • C++ moves to .setup/cpp/; SymofVechCpp() and VechCpp() are in separate files.
